metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: MIGPAX crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C192 H216 Cl8 Ho32 N48 O78 4+,4(Cl1 1-),45(H2 O1),5(C1 H4 O1),2(C2 H3 N1). From the CIF bond table, Ho1 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho2 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho3 (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho4 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho5 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho6 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho7 (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho8 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho9 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho10 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho11 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho12 (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho13 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho14 (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho15 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho16 (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho1A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho2A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho3A (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho4A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho5A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho6A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho7A (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho8A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho9A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho10A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho11A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho12A (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho13A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho14A (Ho) has 6 O neighbors; Ho15A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors; Ho16A (Ho) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 96 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.479-5.004 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 87.17-160.68°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Ho32(L)24(μ3-OH)48(μ4-O)6Cl8]Cl4·45H2O·5CH3OH·2CH3CN. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 48 μ3-OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 μ4-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
